verdict.rationale: Pinecone's security docs say API key permissions can be managed in the console, that RBAC governs access to resources, and that service accounts exist. Together these are a first-party basis for issuing restricted credentials to an agent. The evidence does not show how granular the scopes are or how such a key would be set up for an agent, so least-privilege depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented scope granularity (per-index, per-namespace, read-only vs. write), agent-specific credential guidance, programmatic or API-based key provisioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
